queries_run: Spotify AI-generated music threat streaming substitute 2026

findings.claim: Spotify 在 FY2025 20-F 風險因素揭露：新興技術（含 AI）帶來新的內容消費方式，可能使用戶（尤其年輕族群）轉向其他產品；Apple、Alphabet、Amazon 可能藉由在裝置或作業系統整合 AI 取得競爭優勢。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 3.D Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We also face increasing competition because of new or emerging technologies, including AI, and changes in market conditions. Our current and future competitors have introduced, and may continue to introduce, new ways of consuming or engaging with content that cause our users, especially the younger demographic, to switch to another product or service, which would negatively affect our user retention, growth, and engagement.

findings.claim: Spotify 與 UMG 合作推出授權 AI 混音／翻唱工具供 Premium 用戶使用，CEO 稱其為相對未授權 AI 內容的替代
findings.source: Neowin: Spotify CEO defends AI music

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋僅一次；未找到具體取代 Spotify 核心產品的替代技術之可逐字引用來源，AI 音樂相關線索列於 clues。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
